value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of a family of nonassociative 3D pre-Lie algebras obtained from the smallest irreducible quadratic module. The disappearance of rank-one B directions over the ground field, followed by the appearance of two conjugate four-dimensional geometric components after quadratic extension, is a structural arithmetic boundary, not a small table increment. Explicit all-prime-power rank polynomials and a Hasse–Weil zeta function make the hidden Frobenius geometry measurable and reusable.
